look_here_first: Look for an unwinged perennial stem with mostly opposite coarse leaves and a few very large yellow daisy-like heads. The opposite leaves and lack of stem wings separate it from many other Verbesina.

key_traits.label: Family pattern
key_traits.text: Asteraceae composite heads with yellow ray florets surrounding many yellow disc florets.

key_traits.label: Best field traits
key_traits.text: herbaceous perennial; stems not winged; leaves mostly opposite; coarse ovate to lance-ovate leaves; large solitary or few yellow heads; large ray florets around raised yellow disc; limestone slopes and juniper-oak scrub

key_traits.label: Comparison training
key_traits.text: Compared with Verbesina virginica, V. lindheimeri is shorter with large yellow heads and mostly opposite leaves; frostweed is taller, white-flowered, and often has winged stems.
